key_errors: /home/runner/_work/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp:1370:23: error: conflicting return type specified for 'virtual testing::internal::Function<void(long unsigned int, long unsigned int)>::Result ov::test::{anonymous}::MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async(...)'
src/common/util/include/openvino/util/mmap_object.hpp:85:33: note: overridden function is 'virtual ov::util::PrefetchToken ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async(size_t, size_t)'
root_cause: PR #38993 changed the pure-virtual method ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async in src/common/util/include/openvino/util/mmap_object.hpp (line 85) from returning void to returning util::PrefetchToken, as part of the new PrefetchScheduler feature. The MockMappedMemory test double in src/core/tests/shared_buffer.cpp (a changed file in the PR) was updated to match, but the separate, pre-existing MockMappedMemory mock in the anonymous namespace of src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (not in the PR's changed-files list) was missed and still declares MOCK_METHOD(void, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t, size_t), (override)). This is a deterministic, toolchain-independent compile error (GCC 'conflicting return type', MSVC C2555) that reproduces on every build configuration that compiles ov_core_unit_tests; it has now been seen on Linux RISC-V/GCC, Windows Debug/MSVC, and this ARM64 cross-compilation/GCC build.
reproduction_steps: Configure and build ov_core_unit_tests against the PR branch on any toolchain, e.g.: cmake -G Ninja -DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON -S . -B build && cmake --build build --target ov_core_unit_tests. The error reproduces compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp because its local MockMappedMemory mock still uses the old void-returning signature.
recommended_actions: Update the MOCK_METHOD declaration for hint_prefetch_async in src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (around line 1370) to MOCK_METHOD(ov::util::PrefetchToken, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t offset, size_t size), (override)) to match the new interface signature in mmap_object.hpp:85, mirroring the already-correct mock in src/core/tests/shared_buffer.cpp.
Grep the whole tree for any other MOCK_METHOD/hand-written overrides of MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async that may need the same signature update before re-queueing.
Re-run the full unit test build locally with -Werror before pushing to catch similar interface/mock mismatches early.
prevention_strategies: When changing a pure-virtual method's signature (return type, parameters, or noexcept-ness) in a public interface header, grep the whole tree for MOCK_METHOD/MOCK_CONST_METHOD declarations and hand-written overrides of that method and update all of them in the same commit, not just the ones referenced by the PR's own changed-files list. Add a CI/pre-commit grep check that flags mock declarations whose signature no longer matches the interface they implement.
